notes: Sides (README rule 1): the innermost rule is the thin rule inside the thick bar. Its inner edge was measured column by column wherever paper (a street) lies below it, smoothed along each side with a robust local-linear fit (the frame bows: top ~12 px end to end, left ~9, right ~17), and the outline set ~1.5 px (top, bottom) or ~2 px (left, right) inside that edge (the first clean paper row), points every ~80-250 px. Along the top the hatched and solid blocks run into the thin rule for most of its length (map ink truly touches the rule), so there the outline follows the rule's inner edge through that block ink (kind b: almost all the ink left under the outline); a few vertical street lines touch the rule on the top right too. Corners (rule 2): top-left, the outline runs ~1 px inside the inner edge of the thin (innermost) arc; the hatched blocks at x 460-550 touch the thin arc (kind b); the arc ends at a notch in the thin rule at x 540-546, where the outline steps from the arc's inner edge (y ~359) up to the rule's inner edge (y ~351); from x 547 the hatched block runs into the rule (kind b). The other three corners are unchanged (on paper ~3-4 px inside the thin arc); top-right, a vertical street line meets the arc at x ~4866 (kind b). Bottom: a diagonal line ends 2 px above the thin rule at x ~2450 (~3 ink, left). Remove polygons (README rule 4, owner 2026-11-20): (1) the rotated CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP title, legend and scale block (no ruled box; on open paper; rectangle ~4 px outside its ink), (2) the compass rose with its three long arrows (10-point outline ~4+ px outside the ink, on open bay paper; it overlaps no map ink), (3) the SECTION 1 badge (octagon ~4 px outside the ring, clear of the bottom-right arc). The compass and badge were holes, the badge briefly a notch; the title block was a hole. No holes. 'Join Sec. 2' prints above the top bar and the side note beyond the right bar, so both are outside. BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO, AQUATIC PARK, FERRY BUILDING and pier/street lettering are map. Doubt: at the top-left arc end, the dark band at y 351-358, x 475-545 is read as the arc's tail (it crosses the street at x 522-532), not as the blocks' top edge.
